About RAAHHI TOURS

About RAAHHI TOURS

RAAHHI TOURS offers visa assistance for 41 destinations, activities in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah, and holiday packages in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah. Our team confirms prices, availability and requirements when you enquire.

41visa destinations
36UAE activities
12UAE holiday packages
3emirates with activities

What RAAHHI TOURS does

  • Visa assistance for 41 destinations: understanding the visa options, confirming current requirements and fees, and preparing the information an application needs.
  • UAE activities: 36 desert safaris, city tours, landmarks, theme parks, water parks, cruises and adventure activities in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah.
  • UAE holiday packages: 26 multi-day itineraries based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah, each listing its inclusions.

How enquiries work

  1. Choose a visa destination, activity or holiday package and select Start Visa Enquiry or Enquire.
  2. Enter your details. The website prepares a summary of your enquiry. It is not sent automatically.
  3. Share the summary with our team by phone, WhatsApp or email (see Contact). The team confirms prices, availability and requirements.

Nothing is booked or paid for on this website.

Where RAAHHI TOURS operates

  • UAE activities in Dubai (23), Abu Dhabi (11) and Ras Al Khaimah (2).
  • UAE holiday packages based in Dubai (15), Abu Dhabi (5) and Ras Al Khaimah (6).
  • Visa assistance for 41 destinations worldwide.

How information on this website is presented

  • Activity, package and visa details come from the RAAHHI TOURS catalogue. Prices, hotel names and pickup times that are not recorded are confirmed on enquiry. The page does not substitute estimates.
  • Visa pages link to the official government or tourism-authority source recorded for each destination. The visa type, validity and processing time shown are catalogue values that our team confirms for your trip.
  • Record claims, such as the tallest building or the fastest roller coaster, are only stated with their source (Guinness World Records) and the date the record page was checked.
  • Photos come from Unsplash, Pexels and Wikimedia Commons. Depending on what is verifiably available, a product's photos may be an exact photograph of that attraction, an exact photograph of its location or operator, a historically accurate photograph, or a representative real photograph of a similar experience; a representative photograph does not imply that the venue, operator or vessel pictured is necessarily the one you book. Photos whose licence requires credit are credited beneath the image.
  • Activity browse lists follow catalogue order; search results follow how closely the query matches recorded information. Related suggestions stay within the same destination and use comparison groups, categories, listed duration or package itinerary stops. None of these is a popularity ranking.

What RAAHHI TOURS does not control

  • Visa decisions and processing times, which are set by the relevant government or immigration authority. RAAHHI TOURS does not guarantee visa approval or processing times.
  • Supplier terms for activities and hotels, such as cancellation policies, which are confirmed for each product when you enquire.

Terms of service

These terms explain how the RAAHHI TOURS website works and what happens when you use it. They apply to every visitor.

Use of this website

  • This website is a visa-assistance, activity and holiday-package information and enquiry service operated by RAAHHI TOURS ([BUSINESS LEGAL NAME TO BE CONFIRMED]).
  • By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

Enquiries and applications

  • Using a form on this website prepares a summary of your enquiry on the page. It is not sent to RAAHHI TOURS automatically. Share it with our team using the details on the Contact page.
  • An enquiry or application is not a booking, a reservation or a confirmed order. Nothing is booked, reserved or paid for on this website.
  • RAAHHI TOURS confirms prices, availability, supplier terms and (for visas) requirements directly with you after you enquire.

Product information

  • Activity, package and visa details on this website come from the RAAHHI TOURS catalogue. Where a detail, such as a price, hotel name or pickup time, is not on file, the page says so and states that it is confirmed on enquiry, rather than showing an estimate.
  • Listing status reflects recorded catalogue information. Seasonal experiences need date confirmation, unverified listings require an availability check, and listings recorded as temporarily closed require a reopening check. Actual availability for your dates is confirmed on enquiry.

Visa information

  • Visa information on this website is for guidance only. Visa requirements, fees, processing times and outcomes are set entirely by the relevant government or immigration authority, not by RAAHHI TOURS.
  • RAAHHI TOURS does not guarantee that any visa application will be approved, or that it will be processed within any particular time.
  • Using the visa-enquiry form on this website is not a visa application and does not submit anything to a government authority.

Prices and availability

  • Prices and availability shown or referenced on this website are indicative and are confirmed by RAAHHI TOURS at the time you enquire.
  • RAAHHI TOURS does not currently accept payment through this website (see "Bookings and payments" below).

Third-party suppliers

  • Activities, holiday packages and travel-related services described on this website are provided by third-party operators, hotels and suppliers, not by RAAHHI TOURS itself.
  • Each supplier's own terms, including its cancellation and refund terms, apply to the product you enquire about. RAAHHI TOURS confirms these with you before you commit to anything.

Bookings and payments

  • This website does not currently take bookings or payments, and no payment processor is connected to it.
  • Forms on this website only prepare a summary for you to share with our team; nothing you submit is treated as a completed booking or a successful payment.
  • Once RAAHHI TOURS confirms a booking with you directly, the direct booking confirmation is what applies. Information on this website does not itself confirm a booking.

Cancellations and refunds

  • Because nothing is booked or paid for on this website, no cancellation or refund can be requested through it.
  • Where a product page states a supplier's cancellation policy, that policy is provided for information; it is confirmed, along with any refund terms, when RAAHHI TOURS confirms your booking directly.

Intellectual property

  • The RAAHHI TOURS name, logo and the text written for this website belong to RAAHHI TOURS unless stated otherwise.
  • Photographs on this website are credited to their photographer and licence where the licence requires it, and remain the property of their own copyright holders under their stated licence.
  • You may not copy, redistribute or reuse content from this website for commercial purposes without permission.

Acceptable use

  • You agree not to submit false information, attempt to disrupt the website, or use it for any unlawful purpose.
  • You agree not to attempt to access parts of the website or its data that are not intended for public use.

Limitation of liability

  • This website is provided "as is". RAAHHI TOURS takes reasonable care to keep catalogue information accurate but does not guarantee that every detail is current or error-free.
  • RAAHHI TOURS is not responsible for the acts, omissions, closures or service standards of third-party suppliers, operators, hotels or government authorities named or linked on this website.
  • Nothing in these terms excludes any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Privacy policy

This policy explains what happens to information you provide on this website.

Information you may provide

  • Contact details you type into an activity/package enquiry, callback, visa-enquiry or Contact-page form, such as your name, email address and phone/WhatsApp number.
  • Trip details you choose to share, such as travel dates, number of travellers, nationality and country of residence, and any message you add.
  • This website does not currently accept file uploads, so no documents are submitted through it.

How this website handles that information

  • These forms are not connected to a server or API. This website's own JavaScript validates what you type and prepares a summary on the page; the website itself does not transmit those values anywhere.
  • The website itself does not intentionally store the values you type in cookies, local storage or session storage.
  • Your browser or device may independently remember or autofill form values according to its own settings; that behavior is controlled by your browser/device, not by this website.
  • To actually reach our team, you copy the summary shown after preparing it and share it yourself using the details on the Contact page. From that point, RAAHHI TOURS holds only what you choose to send it that way.

Clipboard ("Copy details")

Where a "Copy details" or "Copy message" button is offered, choosing it copies the prepared summary text to your device's clipboard. Clipboard storage and history are controlled by your browser and operating system, not by this website; the website does not itself send that clipboard text anywhere.

External communication channels

You choose when and how to send the prepared summary, for example by phone, email or WhatsApp. Once you do, you have chosen to transmit that information outside this page: the relevant communication provider may process it under that provider's own operation and policies, and RAAHHI TOURS then receives only what you choose to send. Once you share your enquiry or visa details with our team this way, RAAHHI TOURS uses that information only to respond to your enquiry, confirm prices, availability and requirements, and, if you proceed, to help arrange the activity, package or visa assistance you asked about.

Communications

RAAHHI TOURS uses the contact details you share only to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to follow up on it. This website does not currently offer newsletter or marketing-email signup.

Third-party services this website actually uses

  • Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts.
  • Photographs are loaded from Unsplash, Pexels, Wikimedia Commons and Flickr.
  • When a remote font or image loads, the provider receives ordinary network request information such as your IP address and browser information, plus referrer information allowed by the browser's referrer policy.
  • This website's form JavaScript does not send the contents of your enquiry/contact fields to these font or image providers.
  • This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking services, and does not currently connect to a payment processor, booking system or CRM.

Cookies and local storage

This website's own code does not create first-party cookies for these forms, and does not use your browser's local storage or session storage to persist form details. Separately, your browser or device may offer its own autofill or form-restoration features; that is controlled by your browser/device settings, not by this website.

Data security

No website backend currently receives these forms, so website-side storage of form details does not currently exist. Once you choose to send information to us directly by phone, email or WhatsApp, RAAHHI TOURS handles what it receives with reasonable care.

Retention

This website does not itself store the information you type into its forms, so no retention period applies to it. Once you share details with our team directly, RAAHHI TOURS keeps them only for as long as reasonably needed to handle your enquiry, booking or visa assistance, and in line with applicable law.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights over information you have shared with RAAHHI TOURS directly, such as asking what we hold about you, asking us to correct it, or asking us to delete it, subject to applicable law. To exercise these rights, use the Contact page.
